devin.config.windsurf.marketplaceExtensi: Changes the base URL for marketplace search results. [Available Options](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/blob/master/docs/index.md#extensions-marketplace). You must restart Devin to use the new marketplace after changing this value.
devin.config.windsurf.marketplaceGallery: Changes the base URL on each extension page. [Available Options](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/blob/master/docs/index.md#extensions-marketplace). You must restart Devin to use the new marketplace after changing this value.
devin.config.windsurf.portalUrl.descript: **For multi-tenant deployments (Secure, EU, FedRAMP)**: Base URL of your Devin portal (e.g., `https://your-company.windsurf.com`). Requires a restart after toggling.
devin.config.windsurf.enableCursorImport: Enable the Cursor-import commands in the palette
Enable automatic Lifeguard bug checking on commit.
devin.config.windsurf.lifeguard.mode.des: Analysis mode for Lifeguard bug checking. Fast mode provides quicker results, smart mode provides more thorough analysis, and agent mode uses AI-powered cascade analysis.
devin.config.windsurf.lifeguard.triggerO: Whether to automatically trigger Lifeguard bug checking on commit. When disabled, bug checking must be triggered manually. Default: enabled for Insiders/Next/Dev builds, disabled for Stable.
devin.config.windsurf.lifeguard.showSpin: Show spinning animations for the Lifeguard icon and cancel button
devin.config.windsurf.completionMode.des: Controls the AI completion mode. Supercomplete provides the most capable completions including multi-line suggestions, autocomplete provides standard completions, and off disables AI completions entirely.
devin.config.windsurf.autoContinue.descr: Controls whether Cascade automatically continues when it reaches the invocation limit. 0 or negative means auto-continue is on (Cascade continues indefinitely). A positive value (e.g. 40) means auto-continue is off (Cascade stops at that many invocations and prompts you to continue).
devin.config.windsurf.allowCascadeAccess: Allow Cascade, tab, and supercomplete to view and edit the files in .gitignore.
devin.config.windsurf.cascade.readClaude: When enabled, Cascade will read skills from .claude directories (both local .claude/skills/ and global ~/.claude/skills/).
devin.config.windsurf.acp.preferredAgent: When set to a valid ACP agent connector ID (e.g. 'claude-code', 'opencode', 'gemini', 'devin-cli'), newly created Cascade tabs will automatically select that agent if it is available.
devin.config.windsurf.acp.diffZonesEnabl: When enabled, ACP agent file edits open interactive diff zones with accept/reject controls. When disabled, edits are applied directly and the toolbar shows a simple dismiss button.
devin.config.windsurf.terminal.shellTime: Timeout in milliseconds for the initial terminal shell support probe. Increase if the probe times out in slow environments.
devin.config.windsurf.terminal.cascadePr: Default terminal profile for macOS when using Cascade
Default terminal profile for Linux when using Cascade
Default terminal profile for Windows when using Cascade
Map of ACP agent IDs to enabled/disabled state. Only agents listed here with a value of true will be instantiated.
devin.config.windsurf.acp.agentEnv.descr: Map of ACP agent IDs to environment variables. Each key is an agent ID and the value is an object of environment variable key-value pairs passed to that agent's process.
devin.config.windsurf.acp.agentPreferenc: Map of ACP agent IDs to default session config preferences. Each key is an agent ID and the value is an object mapping config option IDs to their preferred default values, applied automatically when a new session is created.
devin.config.devin.marketplaceExtensionG: Changes the base URL for marketplace search results. [Available Options](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/blob/master/docs/index.md#extensions-marketplace). You must restart Devin to use the new marketplace after changing this value.
devin.config.devin.marketplaceGalleryIte: Changes the base URL on each extension page. [Available Options](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium/blob/master/docs/index.md#extensions-marketplace). You must restart Devin to use the new marketplace after changing this value.
devin.config.devin.portalUrl.description: **For multi-tenant deployments (Secure, EU, FedRAMP)**: Base URL of your Devin portal (e.g., `https://your-company.devin.com`). Requires a restart after toggling.
devin.config.devin.enableCursorImportCur: Enable the Cursor-import commands in the palette
devin.config.devin.environment.descripti: Opt-in backend environment. `beta` switches the api server and Devin web URLs to the beta environment (`server-beta.codeium.com`, `app.beta.devin.ai`). Requires a restart after changing.
devin.config.devin.lifeguard.enabled.des: Enable automatic Lifeguard bug checking on commit.
devin.config.devin.lifeguard.mode.descri: Analysis mode for Lifeguard bug checking. Fast mode provides quicker results, smart mode provides more thorough analysis, and agent mode uses AI-powered cascade analysis.
devin.config.devin.lifeguard.triggerOnCo: Whether to automatically trigger Lifeguard bug checking on commit. When disabled, bug checking must be triggered manually. Default: enabled for Insiders/Next/Dev builds, disabled for Stable.
devin.config.devin.lifeguard.showSpinnin: Show spinning animations for the Lifeguard icon and cancel button
devin.config.devin.completionMode.descri: Controls the AI completion mode. Supercomplete provides the most capable completions including multi-line suggestions, autocomplete provides standard completions, and off disables AI completions entirely.
devin.config.devin.autoContinue.descript: Controls whether Cascade automatically continues when it reaches the invocation limit. 0 or negative means auto-continue is on (Cascade continues indefinitely). A positive value (e.g. 40) means auto-continue is off (Cascade stops at that many invocations and prompts you to continue).
devin.config.devin.allowCascadeAccessGit: Allow Cascade, tab, and supercomplete to view and edit the files in .gitignore.
devin.config.devin.agentNotifications.de: Show native notifications when an agent session finishes or needs your input while in the background.
devin.config.devin.cascade.readClaudeCod: When enabled, Cascade will read skills from .claude directories (both local .claude/skills/ and global ~/.claude/skills/).
devin.config.devin.acp.preferredAgent.de: When set to a valid ACP agent connector ID (e.g. 'claude-code', 'opencode', 'gemini', 'devin-cli'), newly created Cascade tabs will automatically select that agent if it is available. When left unset, new tabs default to Devin Local if it is available, otherwise Cascade.

devin.config.devin.acp.shareTerminalCont: Let Devin see commands and output from your integrated terminal.
devin.config.devin.acp.shareUserEdits.de: Let Devin see which files you edit and create in your workspace.
devin.config.devin.acp.remoteHosts.enabl: Connect to agents on remote machines over SSH.
devin.config.devin.acp.remoteHosts.autoC: Connect to saved hosts automatically on startup.
